subject: SummitOne activation — decision criteria & timeline for routing guarantee
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SummitOne activation — decision criteria & timeline for routing guarantee

Hi Laura / Priyom,

Quick context: SummitOne (deal SUM-2028-0428-01) is asking for a tenant-level routing guarantee (deterministic routing to a pinned model pool + trace retention for 90 days) as part of their activation commitment. They want this in production for a phased go-live by 2028-06-15.

Attached is the customer one-pager and our summary of asks (SummitOne_MVP_requirements.pdf). Key asks:
- Deterministic model routing (tenant pin) with SLA 99.9% routing correctness
- Trace-level export for audit requests (90d retention)
- Telemetry hooks for request/response trace ids + token cost breakdown

Sales motion: SummitOne will sign a 12-month reserved capacity contract and is willing to include an engineering time allocation in the SOW if we need a sprint carveout. Procurement is asking for a clear decision timeline by 2028-05-06.

Asks from Product/Eng:
1) Do we have an acceptable product solution for tenant-level deterministic routing today?
2) If not, what is the MLE (minimum lovable effort) and ETA for a phased rollout (pilot -> prod)?
3) Any known gating items (security / SOC / KMS) that would add time?

I know this is a lot on short notice — happy to coordinate a 30-min sync if useful. SummitOne is strategic for our US mid-market push.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SummitOne_MVP_requirements.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOne activation — decision criteria & timeline for routing guarantee

Monica — thanks for the write-up and the attachment. High-level response: we don't have full deterministic tenant pinning as a GA product feature today; we have model affinity and soft-routing policies. Implementing a strict tenant-level routing guarantee that is SLA-backed has both runtime and orchestration implications (placement, cache warm pools, fallback behavior).

Two clarifying questions before I scope:
- Is the customer requiring hard isolation (no cross-tenant fallbacks) or would a policy of 'prefer pinned pool but fall back if capacity exhausted' be acceptable?
- Is summitOne insisting that the routing guarantee be covered under Redwood's SLA (i.e., refund/credit language) or are they asking for an operational commitment in the SOW without formal credits?

What I can do next: draft a triage scoping note with 1) minimal pilot (config flag + warm pool + telemetry toggle) 2) medium effort (orchestration + eviction controls) with rough engineering estimates. I can get that to you early next week if you confirm the fallback tolerance.

- Laura
Laura Bennett | Product Manager, Routing & Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Gideon Park <gideon.park@summitone.com>, procurement <procurement@summitone.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@summitone.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOne activation — decision criteria & timeline for routing guarantee

Laura — thanks. Quick answers from the customer side (confirmed in call earlier):
- They prefer hard pinning for their transaction-critical flows, but will accept a pilot with 'prefer pinned pool' for non-critical paths during the initial 4-week pilot.
- They want the routing guarantee surfaced in the SOW. They are not asking for credits right now; procurement wants operational commitments + monitoring hooks and clear rollback/fallback playbooks.

SummitOne is committing to:
- 12-month reserved capacity (monthly commit TBD in SOW)
- $120k in pilot engineering funding (explicit line in SOW) to offset dedicated work

HubSpot/DocuSign links below — procurement needs internal decision note by 2028-05-06. If Product can give a pilot scoping by 2028-05-03 that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Monica
[Link: https://hubspot.example/deal/SUM-2028-0428-01]
[Link: https://docuSign.example/SummitOne_SOW]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 May 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOne activation — decision criteria & timeline for routing guarantee

Adding a few technical constraints we've already surfaced with SummitOne during the pilot discussion:
- Telemetry: they want per-request trace id and token-cost breakdown exported to their S3 tenant daily. We'll need a small export pipeline and a documented schema.
- Audit traces: exporting raw traces for 90d has storage and PII considerations. Security needs to sign off on retention policy and redaction rules.

I've attached the telemetry ask doc (telemetry_requirements.xlsx) with the fields SummitOne expects. From an onboarding standpoint, we can run a pilot with 'prefer pinned pool' for all flows except the payment-critical path, which we'll target for hard pinning if the pilot meets performance targets.

Priyom
Priyom Das | Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: telemetry_requirements.xlsx]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOne activation — decision criteria & timeline for routing guarantee

Hi all — quick engineering readout after a sketch review:
- MLE pilot (config flag + warm pool + telemetry export): ~3-4 sprints (6–8 dev weeks) including e2e test coverage; risk: eviction thrash under bursty traffic unless we reserve warm capacity.
- Medium effort (strong tenant pin + orchestration + eviction controls + SLA reporting): ~8–10 sprints (16–20 dev weeks) plus one SRE sprint to bake monitoring/export.

Proposed phased plan:
Phase 0 (1 week): legal/infra checkbox + security scoping (KMS/retention).
Phase 1 (6–8 weeks): Pilot (prefer-pinned + small warm pool + telemetry export).
Phase 2 (16–20 weeks): Hard pinning + SLA reporting + runbook + contractual language.

If SummitOne will fund the 6–8 week pilot line-item in the SOW, we can target a pilot start by 2028-05-20 and a pilot closeout by 2028-07-15. I attached a short implementation plan stub.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: implementation_plan.md]
